items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 10:1
items.html: The upper light that expands from His self is one and simple like His self; and as it is in Ein Sof, so it is even in the world of Assiya, without any change or addition of form whatsoever. It is therefore called “one.” (Part 1, Chapter 2, Inner Light, Item 1)
